title: p2pshop
tagline: A peer to peer shop where sellers offer products to sellers in exchange for crypto
description: A peer to peer shop where sellers offer products to sellers in exchange for crypto. Users create sell requests and the requests are displayed on the explore page. Users can buy from the available items using PYUSD and the sellers are responsible for sending the products when they receive the payment.
how_its_made: It uses the Scaffold-eth framework. It includes Nextjs for the frontend and foundry for the smart contracts. The nextjs uses react and typescript and the smart contracts are written in solidity. In the future it will use IPFS and mongodb to store more information off-chain and reduce gas fees.
